description: Peak-normalize any audio to your target level with a real OfflineAudioContext gain stage — see before/after peaks.

faqs.a: The highest peak is measured, then every sample is scaled so that peak hits exactly your target dB. Nothing clips, nothing is compressed.
0 dBFS is the digital maximum — peaks can't go above it without clipping, so targets stay at or below −0.5 dB for safety.
faqs.q: Why can't I pick 0 dB or higher?

faqs.a: Yes — decoding, measuring and gain all happen in your browser.

howto: Set the target peak level (e.g. −1 dB for masters, −3 dB for podcasts).
Click "Normalize" — original and new peaks are shown.
title: Audio Normalizer
